text.c04: [suspicious] A misty valley… and a strangely good scent.
text.c06: [calmly] I hear water. This must be a land of fine springs.
text.c15: [excited] Look! Giant copper helmets, all in a row!
text.c19: [thoughtfully] Turning sake into cloud with fire… and back into drops.
text.c27: [whispers] They call it the angels' share.
text.c35: [surprised] Cold… such clear water. This water is the soul of the sake.
text.c42: [surprised] My lord — that night at Azuchi… the sake this one brought us!
text.c44: [excited] So this is where it was born!
text.c56: [politely] I would like to take a cask home to Azuchi.
